prose: A second account of the Reuters investigation into McDonald's AI-driven dynamic pricing: machine-learning algorithms continuously analyze transaction data from nearly 14,000 US restaurants to produce an 'optimal price' for each menu item at each location, with one factor being estimated local willingness to pay. Franchisee-facing screenshots show the system flagging when a restaurant's prices diverge from recommendations, and franchisees say identical items now vary in price between neighbouring stores.
highlights: Variant of the Reuters McDonald's AI pricing story (see related summary)
Engine produces per-store 'optimal price' for every menu item
Franchisees report widening price differences within the same area
Screenshots show the interface nudging restaurants toward recommended prices
Reported risks: franchisee friction, customer backlash, antitrust exposure
